home.topUpAverage: {amount} of tokens a month on average

verdict.ledeRecommended: The right fit for this home
verdict.sub: {size} kWp · takes about {area} m² of roof.
verdict.kwp: kWp is the panels' peak power.

doesNotPayBack.title: At your tariff, solar is unlikely to pay for itself.
doesNotPayBack.body: At a typical installer's price, the savings do not cover the cost within {years} years. That is normal for the subsidised classes and for homes with small bills.

heavyShade.title: Your roof is heavily shaded.
heavyShade.body: Have an installer look at the roof before you rely on these figures. Shade can cut the panels' output by more than we allow for.

approximate.title: Approximate.
approximate.body: We could not fetch sun data for your location, so we used the nearest major city's. The figures may be somewhat off.

tooSmall.heading: Roof too small
tooSmall.body: The smallest system needs about {required} m² of roof. The roof you marked is {area} m².
tooSmall.hint: Try marking a larger side of the roof, or add a porch or garage roof that faces the same way.

picker.heading: Try another number of panels
picker.panelRecommended: {count, plural, one {# panel} other {# panels}}, the right fit
picker.belowMinimum: {count, plural, one {# panel} other {# panels}}, below the smallest system
picker.sayRecommended: The right fit: the largest net saving for the power you use by day.
picker.sayFewer: Fewer than the right fit. Some of your daytime use is still not covered by the panels.
picker.sayMore: More than the right fit. {wasted}% of the panels' power goes to the grid unpaid.

day.heading: A day in your home
day.caption: The panels make {generated} kWh a day. {used} kWh is used straight away in the home, and {exported} kWh flows to the grid unpaid.

payback.heading: When it pays back
payback.captionRange: Savings cover the upfront cost in year {low} to year {high}, depending on the installer's price.
payback.captionOne: Savings cover the upfront cost in year {low}.
payback.captionOpen: At the lowest installer price, savings cover the upfront cost in year {low}. At the highest, they do not within {years} years.
payback.captionNever: Within {years} years, savings do not cover the upfront cost at this number of panels.
payback.captionNet: After {years} years, the net saving is about {net}.
payback.captionLoss: After {years} years, at a typical price, you lose about {loss}.

battery.headingNotWorth: A battery does not pay yet
battery.note: A battery stores spare daytime power for the evening. It also helps during a blackout, but we do not count that in rupiah.
battery.none: At this number of panels, too little power is left over by day to fill the smallest battery, so we do not offer one.
battery.caption: The same system without and with a battery

next.heading: What happens next
next.surveyBody: An installer checks your roof and gives you a firm price.
next.applyBody: PLN takes rooftop solar applications twice a year, in January and July.
next.installBody: A licensed business does the installation, and only after PLN has approved it.
next.prepaid: You are on prepaid tokens. When your panels are approved, PLN moves you to a monthly bill.
next.quotaBody: PLN sets a rooftop solar quota for each area. SuryaPas does not know how much is left in yours.

actions.quoteThanks: Thank you. We have noted your interest, without keeping any personal data.
actions.quoteFailed: Your interest was not recorded. Try tapping once more.
actions.copyFailed: The link was not copied. Copy this page's address from the address bar.
actions.shared: This result was shared by link. You can view it, but not change it.
actions.exampleNote: This is an example house. Its figures come from the same calculation.

method.margin: Panel output is worked out hour by hour from NASA sun data for your location. On a flat roof it comes within about 10% of PVGIS, the European Commission's solar calculator.
